$Comment: An easy delivery: a tithe of Life essence, handed back at the board. TURN_IN on the exact essence id, and a contract is always handed back at the board that posted it, so there is no place to author; the essence can come from a table, a farm or a chest, which is what keeps this one easy. Weight 2 makes it twice as likely as an even rival for the same easy slot. This file spells out its whole step and pay rather than inheriting a shared skeleton, so it loads with nothing but this pack, RPG Stations and the MMO installed; it hangs on the Daily board by id, and on a server with no board of that id it is simply never posted. The stations feature condition in Requires hides the contract rather than locking it: it is lifted out of the gate when the contract loads and the board's draw reads it live, so on a server where stations have been switched off the contract never takes a slot and is never posted, rather than being offered and refused at Accept.
